scope: Isolated PPT native text API feasibility, not IM tool implementation
findings: Selecting a placeholder shape without entering text edit mode: pluginMethod_InputText is a no-op with no history change.
pluginMethod_PasteText creates a new text shape, not a replacement of selected placeholder: shape count 2 to 3, history -1 to 0.
Native Undo restores original two shapes, empty texts and history index.
limitations: SDK feasibility only, not IM implementation/model planning validation.
Blank default slide only; layout/text-edit-state/selection/read-only/lifetime and target expiration not tested.
